name: Greater Mark Of Storm
description: General Feat (Prerequisite: Level 4+, Mark of Storm Feat) You gain the following benefits.

features.name: Ability Score Increase
features.description: Increase one ability score of your choice by 1, to a maximum of 20.

features.name: Improved Intuition
features.description: When you use the Windwright’s Intuition benefit of your Mark of Storm feat, you can roll 1d6 instead of 1d4.

features.name: Improved Storm
features.description: When you use the Storm Magic benefit of your Mark of Storm feat to cast Gust of Wind without a spell slot, you also gain a Fly Speed of 60 feet for the duration of the spell.
